purpose: Executable ledger for the `public-record-custody` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: A carrier can make a record findable, citable, replayable, or challengeable, but carrier publicness is not candidate-native identifiability unless the route row, acquisition protocol, promotion gate, negative controls, and observed-sector obligations also pass.

carrier_rows.record_object: persistent identifiers, metadata records, provenance statements, version tags, custody notes, and access conditions attached to route artifacts
carrier_rows.custody_object: versioned metadata / provenance bundle, not the scientific record by itself
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: metadata-schema, DOI, repository, or archive landing-page locator
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: FAIR, W3C PROV, and DataCite-style metadata where applicable
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: identify entities, activities, agents, timestamps, versions, derivations, and access conditions for each claimed record carrier
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: metadata must point to the actual carrier and enough version/custody information for fresh-host retrieval or replay attempt
carrier_rows.challenge_route: challenge the record by checking identifier resolution, version parity, provenance lineage, access reproducibility, and artifact-carrier match
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: mutable or unversioned metadata cannot spend more than navigation credit until frozen or version-addressed
known_failure_modes: repository pointer confused with candidate-native record

carrier_rows.record_object: published proof, derivation, theorem, consistency calculation, or formal sector map with stated assumptions
carrier_rows.custody_object: publication and any supplementary code or formal notes
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: paper, preprint, journal article, theorem notes, or public repository
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: citation metadata plus version/provenance wrapper where possible
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: declare assumptions, definitions, regulator/truncation choices, duality frame, and dependency sources
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: independent derivation check or formal proof replay where feasible; otherwise citation-public only
carrier_rows.challenge_route: look for hidden borrowed ontology, missing observed-sector bridge, non-portable definitions, or theorem-to-world target shift
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: route credit follows the exact proof version and cannot be transferred to later summary wording without rebasing
known_failure_modes: formal consistency mistaken for empirical acquisition

carrier_rows.record_object: boundary states, correlators, entropy inputs, code-subspace declaration, reconstruction map, decoder output, and benchmark failure cases
carrier_rows.custody_object: versioned benchmark, code, state/data description, and decoder/reconstruction script
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: paper plus public code/data benchmark or formal theorem package
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: FAIR/PROV metadata plus route-local code/data versioning
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: declare source states, code space, dictionary, reconstruction algorithm, training or proof dependencies, and exclusion cases
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: fresh-host decoder or theorem replay with declared input/output equivalence and negative-control cases
carrier_rows.challenge_route: test outside code space, vary dictionary, perturb boundary data, attempt dual-description decoys, and check state-dependence
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: benchmark credit is version-bound and cannot generalize beyond its code-space / target quotient
known_failure_modes: public replay of surrogate target only

carrier_rows.carrier_class: simulation / inverse / RG / causal-set benchmark package
carrier_rows.record_object: code, parameters, random seeds, input data, model outputs, loss surfaces, benchmark tasks, and holdout cases
carrier_rows.custody_object: versioned code/data bundle with dependency lock and run instructions
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: repository, archived release, supplementary benchmark, or computational notebook
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: FAIR/PROV/DataCite metadata plus dependency lock and environment hash where possible
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: declare data generation, preprocessing, priors, hyperparameters, truncations, regulators, and randomization state
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: fresh-host rerun plus at least one perturbation or holdout replay, not just a screenshot or summary table
carrier_rows.challenge_route: rerun with altered seeds, priors, truncations, regulators, holdouts, or no-inversion cases
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: credit is tied to archived release and environment; floating repositories remain forecast or navigation credit

carrier_rows.record_object: preparation logs, interferometric phases, entanglement witnesses, mediator-dynamics diagnostics, calibration traces, nuisance logs, and analysis code
carrier_rows.custody_object: laboratory data package with calibration, blinding, nuisance, and chain-of-custody notes
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: public protocol, data release, archived logs, and analysis package after experiment realization
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: FAIR/PROV metadata plus laboratory calibration and data-management records
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: trace preparation, isolation, environmental monitors, mass/position calibration, analysis cuts, and alternative mediator tests
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: independent rerun or cross-site protocol challenge before moving beyond class-discriminator credit
carrier_rows.challenge_route: classical-hybrid mediator, subsystem-independence, noise, decoherence, and detector artifact controls
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: claim credit follows frozen experimental run, calibration version, and analysis pipeline

carrier_rows.carrier_class: single-graviton / graviton-counting laboratory or detector catalog
carrier_rows.record_object: trigger-correlated transition/click records, count distributions, correlation functions, tomography outputs, backgrounds, and detector-response models
carrier_rows.custody_object: proposal-level carrier until realized; then frozen detector/lab catalog with calibration and trigger association
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: proposal, mission record, lab data release, or gravitational-wave event correlation package
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: FAIR/PROV metadata plus detector calibration, trigger, and source-state provenance
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: trace source event, detector state, background model, transition model, trigger window, and analysis chain
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: fresh-host inference plus independent trigger/background challenge; ideally independent detector confirmation
carrier_rows.challenge_route: source-state, detector-response, background, and interaction-model decoys
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: forecast rows remain P0 until realized; realized records must freeze trigger/correlation and detector model versions
known_failure_modes: single-quantum access mistaken for ToE identity

carrier_rows.carrier_class: gravitational-wave strain / event / catalog public data carrier
carrier_rows.record_object: calibrated strain, segment lists, event records, waveform products, GR/deviation tests, tutorials, and analysis tools where released
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: event/catalog metadata, data-quality segments, calibration notes, and FAIR/PROV wrapper where possible
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: trace detector, observing run, calibration, data-quality selection, waveform model, and analysis version
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: fresh-host reanalysis of released strain or catalog products with waveform/calibration declarations
carrier_rows.challenge_route: calibration, waveform, selection, detector-network, and model-degeneracy controls
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: catalog credit follows named release and event products; live event pages are not frozen carriers
known_failure_modes: GR consistency mistaken for ToE selection

carrier_rows.carrier_class: survey catalog / BAO likelihood / cosmology-chain public data carrier
carrier_rows.record_object: spectra, redshifts, target selection, BAO likelihoods, covariance matrices, chains, best fits, and systematic tests
carrier_rows.custody_object: survey data release and cosmology product release
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: DESI data-release portal or associated repository
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: survey-release metadata, covariance / chain documentation, and FAIR/PROV wrapper where possible
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: trace target selection, pipeline version, catalog construction, covariance, likelihood, priors, and cross-survey combination choices
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: fresh-host likelihood replay and systematic / parameterization variation
carrier_rows.challenge_route: survey systematics, nuisance priors, parameterization dependence, data-combination choices, and growth/BAO/SNe/CMB consistency
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: cosmology credit follows named data/product release and likelihood version

carrier_rows.carrier_class: CMB maps / spectra / likelihood / forecast-to-data carrier
carrier_rows.record_object: polarization maps, foreground models, delensing products, likelihoods, tensor constraints, and null-channel validation records
carrier_rows.custody_object: mission/archive data products and likelihood packages
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: NASA LAMBDA / mission archive / experiment data-release portal
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: mission data-product metadata, likelihood documentation, and FAIR/PROV wrapper where possible
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: trace frequency maps, masks, calibration, foreground model, delensing method, likelihood version, and cross-experiment validation
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: fresh-host likelihood replay plus foreground/lensing/null-channel perturbations
carrier_rows.challenge_route: foreground, lensing, instrument, reheating/model, and many-mechanism tensor decoys
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: forecast rows remain P0; empirical credit follows named map/likelihood release

carrier_rows.carrier_class: publication-linked high-energy-physics tables / EFT coefficient carrier
carrier_rows.record_object: tabular measurements, scattering constraints, Wilson coefficient inputs, uncertainties, and publication-linked data products
carrier_rows.custody_object: HEPData or equivalent publication-linked table release
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: open-access HEP data repository or publication data supplement
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: repository metadata, citation, data-table provenance, and FAIR/PROV wrapper where possible
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: trace publication, observable, binning, uncertainties, correction factors, and coefficient-extraction assumptions
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: fresh-host coefficient or amplitude-bound extraction from released tables and assumptions
carrier_rows.challenge_route: basis choice, EFT truncation, loop/gravity correction, uncertainty, and UV-completion degeneracy controls
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: constraint credit follows named repository record and extraction script version
known_failure_modes: coefficient bound mistaken for unique completion

carrier_rows.record_object: source/target frame definition, transported observables, preserved/nonpreserved quantities, equivalence rule, and failure cases
carrier_rows.custody_object: formal protocol, theorem, or benchmarked toy model for same-record transport
carrier_rows.locator_or_access_class: paper, proof artifact, or public benchmark notebook
carrier_rows.metadata_standard: citation/provenance metadata plus explicit frame-domain declarations
carrier_rows.provenance_requirements: trace frames, transformations, domain of validity, measured quantities, and nonpreserved quantities
carrier_rows.replay_requirements: apply transformation to named records and verify same-record equivalence or abstention condition
carrier_rows.challenge_route: noncommuting-observable, ideal-frame, boundary, and causal-domain decoys
carrier_rows.versioning_or_freeze_rule: credit is limited to the declared frame domain and exact equivalence rule
known_failure_modes: frame-local sharpness mistaken for public fact
